title: Shut down the Linux system
summary: Safely power off your computer. The system will ask all running programs to close properly before turning off.

steps.explain: This command tells the system to shut down. It sends a signal to all services to stop gracefully, ensuring data is saved and processes are closed correctly.
steps.expect: The system will begin shutting down and the screen will go black.

rollback.explain: If you accidentally initiated a shutdown and the system hasn't fully powered off yet, you can cancel it by pressing Ctrl+C in the terminal where you ran the command, or by running the reboot command if the system is still responsive.

warnings: Make sure you have saved all your work before running this command.
Unsaved data in open applications may be lost if they do not handle the shutdown signal correctly.
